metadata.description: curated set of GitHub Copilot and Claude Code customization plugins for LifeSG web application development.

plugins.name: ccube-fds-web-app-builder
plugins.description: VS Code agent plugin that builds web applications strictly following the Flagship Design System — enforces FDS components, tokens, and accessibility patterns across every Copilot suggestion.

plugins.name: ccube-software-craft
plugins.description: VS Code agent plugin for software engineering knowledge — SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code, architecture styles, git workflow, testing strategy, and debugging methodology.

plugins.name: ccube-frontend-dev
plugins.description: VS Code agent plugin for frontend development knowledge — React 18/19 patterns, React fundamentals, CSS essentials, and styled-components best practices.

plugins.name: ccube-ux-designers
plugins.description: VS Code agent plugin for UX designers — creates and validates DESIGN.md files by browsing live design system documentation directly in the integrated browser.
